description: u-maker hooks. PreToolUse: on-edit-guard.js is the side-effect gatekeeper — it asks for explicit user approval only before ALREADY-IMPLEMENTED, DEPENDED-UPON code (git-tracked + clean = committed/shipped AND imported/referenced by another source file) in a u-maker project is modified (Edit/Write/MultiEdit/Bash), so a fix to shared code cannot introduce silent regressions in its dependents (the prompt names them). New files, in-progress (untracked/dirty) files, and LEAF files that nothing imports are NOT gated, so forward construction and self-contained fixes stay friction-free. (Caveat: the dependent check is an import-graph scan — API routes / DB schema / env contracts are not detected and remain the agent's Step 0.5 responsibility.) Mode via U_MAKER_EDIT_GATE=off|strict(every existing file)|auto (default auto). Wired directly, NOT through _dispatch.js (which never blocks). PostToolUse: reactive hooks keep dropzone index, doc<->JSON sync, gate loop state, and deploy staleness in sync after file mutations, dispatched through _dispatch.js.
